annotation.title_clean: ロボティクス・メカトロニクスの現状と展望 ロボティクス・メカトロニクス部門の活動実績とPSからの将来への期待
annotation.title_en: Current Status and Prospects of Robotics and Mechatronics: Activity Report of the Robotics and Mechatronics Division and Expectations from the Policy Statement
annotation.venue: 日本機械学会2015年度年次大会講演論文集
annotation.summary_en: Conference report by the JSME Robotics and Mechatronics Division reviewing 2014 developments in Japanese robotics (national robot strategy, Fukushima decommissioning, Robot White Paper) and the division's five-year policy statement, and proposing community-based robotics. It addresses innovation, social implementation and talent development, not regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: 2014 was a landmark year for robotics in Japan, with national robot strategy and the Robot Revolution Realization Council.
Division policy: internationalization, youth engagement, industry collaboration, membership growth, and visible social contribution.
Technology roadmap to be rolled over and updated every three years.
Promotes community-based robotics with common middleware such as RT middleware and RSNP.
Continued robotics support for Fukushima decommissioning and workforce development.
